historical_audit_decisions.locked_request: Check-in/out and small Court action at the top; remove Plan and the bottom action stack.

historical_audit_decisions.acceptance: Compare against approved top action placement; no Home Plan control and no bottom action block.

historical_audit_decisions.locked_request: Conroe replaces the house at the top-right, aligned with the sport label.

historical_audit_decisions.acceptance: Persist favorites; enforce entitlement on the server; switch Home and Schedule without replacing favorites. Paid numeric cap remains unspecified.

historical_audit_decisions.locked_request: Locals belongs on the court page, ranked by Elo; no extra unselected sorting options.
historical_audit_decisions.current: Court Players view remains; Home still has Locals. Removing Home Locals is not done.
historical_audit_decisions.acceptance: Court locals remain accessible and Elo ordered; Home has no Locals tab.

historical_audit_decisions.locked_request: Use the locked understated dot / VS / calendar treatment; no bright outlined or glowing check-in icons.

historical_audit_decisions.acceptance: Compare Home, court feed and player activity directly to feed-understated.png. Preserve event distinctions; remove dominant orange glow.

historical_audit_decisions.locked_request: Use consistent event hierarchy for recent and older checkout rows.

historical_audit_decisions.acceptance: Same event type has the same primary/secondary information order across day boundaries; keep useful duration/time.

historical_audit_decisions.locked_request: Normal-size h with clear space; do not shrink h to solve crowding.
historical_audit_decisions.current: MetricValue adds thin spacing but sets the unit to 16pt while numerals are 22–28pt. The attached current Home image visibly retains the small h.
historical_audit_decisions.acceptance: Hours render with the agreed full-size unit and sufficient spacing across Home, cards, drawer and Info.

historical_audit_decisions.locked_request: Busy chart above the court tabs, following the chosen middle D/header reference.
historical_audit_decisions.current: Court header now shows name on the left, a large live count on the right and the daily chart above all tabs.
historical_audit_decisions.acceptance: Fresh capture of each court tab at the review head confirms header and chart; check long names.

historical_audit_decisions.locked_request: Fade / blur the background court art so it does not compete with text.
historical_audit_decisions.current: Header still renders CourtArt with no change to that art component in this PR. Text shadow is not evidence of the requested art blur/fade.
historical_audit_decisions.acceptance: Show a populated, long-name court header at small and large sizes with subdued art.

historical_audit_decisions.locked_request: Data view only: remove Check-in and Plan Visit; availability creation stays on standalone Schedule.
historical_audit_decisions.current: Court page still renders Plan Visit and CheckInButton; interactive Week actions also remain. These actions existed before this PR, so this is an unfulfilled removal request, not proven newly introduced behavior.
historical_audit_decisions.acceptance: Court tabs show data without the rejected check-in/planning footer or duplicate availability controls.

historical_audit_decisions.locked_request: Faithfully use selected 2d composition, with seven days across, 6 AM–midnight down, taller heatmap and prominent attendance.
historical_audit_decisions.current: Days are across and hours down, but the old short AM/PM time window remains. The captured view has a separate Add My Time box and separate upcoming game card. This is not the selected combined card/full-height composition.
historical_audit_decisions.acceptance: Show selected mock alongside implementation; apply axis exception, use available height and show prominent actual attendance. Verify 6 AM–midnight range rather than copying mock labels.

historical_audit_decisions.locked_request: Keep favorite court selector at top; Add time / plus and Schedule game accessible here.
historical_audit_decisions.current: One-line court picker is restored and planning/game creation are available through existing controls. Favorites and selected top pill/composition are not implemented; the orange floating + remains.
historical_audit_decisions.acceptance: Selected dropdown and both actions fit the approved layout and remain usable; no floating control hides a card action.

historical_audit_decisions.locked_request: Avoid unnecessary scrolling and keep primary actions visible.
historical_audit_decisions.current: Standalone Schedule now uses an outer ScrollView when content cannot fit; CourtSchedulePanel has outer and inner vertical scroll areas. This prevents some clipping, but is different from the repeated no-page-scroll request. Repo docs simultaneously say never scrolls and allow small-phone scrolling.
historical_audit_decisions.acceptance: At 375, 393 and 430 widths, verify agreed composition and reachable actions; document unavoidable accessibility overflow as an explicit exception.

historical_audit_decisions.locked_request: Axis labels closer to grid; compact equal columns and buttons; centered empty game text.
historical_audit_decisions.current: Month/hour labels are right aligned against the grid, columns use equal flex bases, empty text is centered and shared smaller buttons replace bespoke controls.
historical_audit_decisions.acceptance: Compare empty and populated selected slots; full names and text fit without shrinking below agreed scale.

historical_audit_decisions.locked_request: Preserve card → peek → expanded drawer and reachable check-in. Fix Here Now clipping.
historical_audit_decisions.current: Shared measured peek and fixed expanded layout are implemented. Latest PR comment explicitly reports intermittent 375×667 peek expansion showing half of Here Now, about one run in two.
historical_audit_decisions.acceptance: Repeatedly open/close populated and empty drawers at 375/393/430; no clipped tiles or accidental larger peek.

historical_audit_decisions.locked_request: Daily activity view without heading/day label, arrows or Busiest commentary; heatmap owns the double-click interaction.

historical_audit_decisions.locked_request: Remove Busiest around commentary.
historical_audit_decisions.current: busyCaption still generates Busiest around and explanatory text. It is displayed in the court header and drawer.
historical_audit_decisions.acceptance: No visible Busiest sentence in the affected chart surfaces; retain accessible chart meaning.

historical_audit_decisions.locked_request: Narrow live count; legend top-left; map controls bottom-right.
historical_audit_decisions.current: Native legend moved from lower-left to a centered row under the live count; locate-me moved into bottom row. The top-left placement is not implemented. No web map implementation file is changed in this PR, so web/native parity is unproven.
historical_audit_decisions.acceptance: Capture working web and native maps: compact status, top-left legend, bottom-right relevant controls without overlapping nearest action.

historical_audit_decisions.locked_request: Reduce repeated court/format/host metadata; preserve meaningful date, attendance and game type.
historical_audit_decisions.current: Court name is in the top bar; duplicate Where/Host detail rows are removed. Format still appears as a metric and can also occur in the stored title, as PHONETEST · 3V3 does. Do not silently rewrite stored titles.
historical_audit_decisions.acceptance: Verify title containing 3v3 and title without it; one intentional format treatment and clear ranked/casual state.

historical_audit_decisions.acceptance: On phone: full 5v5 and started game, keyboard and safe area; action remains visible and opens correct flow.

historical_audit_decisions.locked_request: Game On and Waiting open the same dedicated challenge/game detail flow, not generic Log Game.

historical_audit_decisions.locked_request: More space below Challenges heading and between cards.

historical_audit_decisions.locked_request: Short action label, separate account error; better balanced content and better graphic.

historical_audit_decisions.locked_request: Shorten the redundant two-line notifications helper.

historical_audit_decisions.locked_request: Stable centered welcome-art frame across screen heights; better blend.
historical_audit_decisions.status: Partial implementation; not verified across real devices
historical_audit_decisions.current: PR explicitly computes art width and subject position and adds fades. Hero height still depends on window height and flex space; code intent alone does not establish the desired composition.
historical_audit_decisions.acceptance: Compare actual iPhone short/tall safe areas and keyboard-free welcome to approved centered composition, no drift or gap.

historical_audit_decisions.locked_request: Lower username/sport fields; remove obvious helper copy; maintain editable username and accessible short constraint.
historical_audit_decisions.current: This is how locals will know you, first-name suggestion and sport explanation remain. Form is still top padded. Username input is editable except while saving; reported editing/focus failure needs reproduction.
historical_audit_decisions.acceptance: Remove rejected copy, rebalance form, test delete/replace/type without forced blur; label actual failure only after reproducing.

historical_audit_decisions.locked_request: Selected court gets orange top-down rectangle; confirm uses existing Add Court dolly/tilt/rotate, then auto check-in permission.

historical_audit_decisions.locked_request: After auto-check-in choice, enter app; remove separate notifications step from this sequence.

historical_audit_decisions.locked_request: Concise product language; truthful foreground and background location explanation.
historical_audit_decisions.current: Discovery says location once; auto-check-in screen separately requests background capability. These can be separate stages, but privacy promises must be checked against actual service behavior, not inferred from UI.
historical_audit_decisions.acceptance: Document location collection, retention and geofencing behavior; approved concise copy accurately distinguishes nearby discovery from opt-in auto-check-in.
